mapper.insert: insert into task_comment ( task_comment_no, task_no project_name_no, task_comment_content, task_comment_ctime, task_comment_utime ) values( #{taskCommentNo}, #{taskNo}, #{projectNameNo}, #{taskCommentContent}, #{taskCommentCtime}, #{taskCommentUtime) )
mapper.select: select tc.task_comment_no as taskCommentNo, tc.task_no as taskNo, tc.project_member_no as projectMemberNo, tc.task_comment_content as taskCommentContent, tc.task_comment_ctime as taskCommentCtime, tc.task_comment_utime as taskCommentUtime, u.emp_no as empNo, u.emp_name as empName, u.emp_dept_no as empDeptNo, u.emp_position_no as empPositionNo from task_comment tc inner join project_member pm on tc.project_member_no = pm.project_member_no inner join emp e on pm.emp_no = u.emp_no where tc.task_no = #{taskNo} order by tc.task_comment_ctime asc

select task_comment_no as taskCommentNo, task_no as taskNo, project_member_no as projectMemberNo, task_comment_content as taskCommentContent, task_comment_ctime as taskCommentCtime, task_comment_utime as taskCommentUtime, from task_comment where task_comment_no = #{taskCommentNo}
mapper.update: update task_comment set task_comment_content = #{taskCommentContent}, task_comment_utime = systimestamp where task_comment_no = #{taskCommentNo}
